notes.title: For the People 1.1.3 update — full patch notes
notes.notes:
We have spent the last week improving For the People and are ready to deploy another patch to make your gaming experience a breeze! The patch will be released today for all versions of the game.

Many players pointed out certain imperfections in agent missions, so we have revamped the agent appointing algorithm and added quite a bit of new content while we were at it. Here’s a shortlist of the main changes:

[list]
[*] Whereas before an agent's skills played a pivotal role in whether they were suitable for a mission, now more emphasis should be put on the individual agent's background.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Agents’ dossiers were slightly adjusted and simplified so that the player can make a decision regarding an agent faster.
[/list]
[list]
[*] We also revised the outcomes of most missions when it comes to agent failures - the descriptions will now be more definitive and detailed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Repetitive paragraphs in the agent mission descriptions and some of the mission outcomes have been removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] One of the repetitive citizen appeals, written by an old man complaining about the noise, can potentially affect the ending of the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Achievements connected to the individual districts’ opinion of the City Committee and citizen happiness will now be somewhat easier to unlock.
[/list]

Important notice: changes made to the agents will only be applied when starting a new game and will not affect existing progress.

We hope that these changes will make your gaming experience even more pleasant. As always, please continue to give us your feedback about specific For the People cases that feel excessive in this topic on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1146600/discussions/0/4325098189133146829/]Steam[/url] or in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/h9g48vy]Discord[/url]. Thank you for your reports and patience!

notes.title: For the People 1.0.5 update — full patch notes
For the People 1.0.3 update - full patch notes
Release date postponed until August 13th
notes.notes:
Comrades, we have an important announcement!

After some consideration, we’ve made a tough call to move the launch of For the People from July 30th to August 13th.

Studio Brezg and 101XP teams are very grateful for the interest you’ve shown in the game, your continuous support, patience, and the useful feedback you gave us.
We are currently in the home stretch of the development process and localization, however, there is some work to be done and imperfections to be polished out in order to achieve the best possible result.

Our sincerest apologies for the delay. We hope you’re going to be pleasantly surprised by the finished product.

Brezg and 101XP

notes.title: Release date announcement & new trailer - 30th of July, 2020.
notes.notes:
Hey, Comrades!

With a sense of accomplishment and pride, we are thrilled to finally announce [b]the release date of For the People[/b] - [b]July 30, 2020.[/b]

To celebrate the occasion, we have prepared a renewed trailer for your enjoyment. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=PfRG6IsURMI;full][/previewyoutube]

For the People is an acute social novel with strategic elements that puts the player in the shoes of a state official.

The game will be available for Windows, Mac OS, and Linux users in four languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and German. To see the full system requirements please navigate to the For the People Steam page.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/


Remember that until the [b]30th of July[/b] you can also enjoy the free demo version of the game available in English and Russian. 
[b]
We’d also appreciate it if you could help us get the word out. Here’s how you can do it:[/b]

[/list]
[list]
[*] Tell you favorite Youtuber, Streamer, or News site about the upcoming release;
[/list]
[list]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]


101XP and Brezg studio team.
